feed.title: LiveParse Developer Tool Updates
feed.subtitle: Recent local-first developer tools and standards-based guides published by LiveParse.

entry.title: Business Days Calculator
entry.summary: Calculate 5, 7, 10, 30, or 45 business days from today, or count workdays between dates with configurable weekends and holidays.

entry.title: Morse Code Translator
entry.summary: Translate English text to International Morse code or decode spaced dots and dashes back to text, then copy or play the result.

entry.title: Age Calculator
entry.summary: Calculate exact calendar age from a birth date to today in years, months, and days with an explicit leap-day policy.

entry.title: Age Calculator on a Specific Date
entry.summary: Find an exact calendar age on a chosen past or future reference date without timezone-dependent timestamp subtraction.

entry.title: Date Calculator
entry.summary: Add or subtract days, weeks, months, or years from a date with transparent end-of-month clamping.

entry.title: Days Between Dates Calculator
entry.summary: Count elapsed days between two dates with explicit inclusive or exclusive endpoint choices and a calendar breakdown.

entry.title: Time Duration Calculator
entry.summary: Calculate hours and minutes between clock times with overnight handling and an optional break duration.

entry.title: ISO Week Number Calculator
entry.summary: Find the ISO 8601 week-year, week number, weekday, and Monday-to-Sunday range for a date.

entry.title: Birthday Countdown
entry.summary: Count calendar days until the next birthday and see the next birthday date and age under a stated leap-day rule.

entry.title: Calendar Date Arithmetic, DST, and Leap Years
entry.summary: Understand elapsed days, calendar age, month-end clamping, leap-day birthdays, workdays, ISO weeks, and DST boundaries.

entry.title: Image Compressor to 20KB, 50KB, 100KB, 200KB, or 500KB
entry.summary: Compress JPEG, PNG, or WebP images toward a chosen KB limit in the browser, with honest target status, dimensions, and file-size comparisons.

entry.title: Image Resizer by Pixels or Percent
entry.summary: Resize JPEG, PNG, or WebP images by pixels or percent with aspect-ratio, contain, cover, no-upscale, format, and quality controls.

entry.title: PNG to JPG Converter
entry.summary: Convert PNG images to JPEG locally with explicit quality and background-color controls for transparent pixels.

entry.title: WebP to JPG Converter
entry.summary: Convert static WebP images to JPEG locally while choosing output quality and the background behind transparent pixels.

entry.title: WebP to PNG Converter
entry.summary: Convert static WebP images to PNG in the browser, preserving decoded transparency while reporting the likely file-size tradeoff.

entry.title: Image Compression, Formats, Dimensions, and File Size
entry.summary: Understand how dimensions, codec, quality, transparency, animation, and metadata affect image file size before compressing or converting.

entry.title: International Morse Code Reference
entry.summary: Compare International Morse letters, digits, punctuation, token separators, signal timing, prosigns, and decoding limits against the ITU recommendation.

entry.title: Contador de palabras
entry.summary: Cuenta palabras, frases, párrafos y líneas con segmentación configurada para español y estimaciones ajustables de lectura y locución.

entry.title: Contador de caracteres
entry.summary: Compara grafemas visibles, caracteres sin espacios, puntos de código, unidades UTF-16 y bytes UTF-8 sin normalizar el texto.

entry.title: 文字数カウント
entry.summary: 空白を含む・含まない文字数と、書記素・コードポイント・UTF-16・UTF-8の違いをブラウザ内で確認します。
